sanskrit: guhyād guhyataraṃ guhyaṃ siddhasadbhāvasantatiḥgopanīyaṃ prayatnena yadīcchan śāśvataṃ padamyathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare samupāgatāḥsarvādhāramaśeṣasya jagataḥ sarvadā prabhuḥajānantamalairgrastā mahāmāyāndhacchāditāḥna vindanti padaṃ śāntaṃ kaulānāṃ niṣkalaṃ gurumbaudhāstu arihantā ye somasiddhantavādinaḥitihāsapurāṇañca bhūtatatvantu gāruḍamsavikalpasiddhisañcāraṃ tat sarvaṃ pāpabandhavitna te muñcanti saṃsāre akulavīravivarjitāḥsarveṣāṃ siddhistatrasthā sarvasiddhiñca tatra vaitaṃ viditvā paraṃ rūpaṃ mano niścalatāṃ vrajetsarvabhāvāśca tatraiva pralīṇāḥ pralayaṃ gatāḥsvabhāvamatimataṃ śāntaṃ mano yasya manomayamnādhāralakṣabhedantu na nādagocare paṭhetna iḍā piṅgalā śāntā na cāstīti gamāgametathā cakṣurunmīlane ca na nāsāgranirīkṣaṇena bindubhedake granthau lalāṭe na tu vahnikena karaṇairnāsanaṃ mudrairnāmāse bhinnatāluke (?)na preryaprerakañcaiva na sthānannaiva cāśrayamsabāhyābhyantarantatra ekoccāraṃ carācaramna unno na so'dhika ebhiḥ pakṣairvivarjitamyatra lakṣaṃ na vidyeta akulavīra sa ucyatesa brahmā so hariśceśaḥ sa rudro sa ca īśvaraḥsa ca sāṃkhyaḥ purāṇāśca arhantabuddha eva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00003 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svayaṃ dhyānaṃ svayaṃ dhyātā svayaṃ sarvatra devatātādṛśaṃ phalamā(va)pnoti nātra kāryavicāraṇātanāma tasya gīyante bhrāntijñānavimohitaiḥtena muñcanti saṃsāraṃ narakaṃ yonisaṃkulamsa bāhyābhyantare nityaṃ ekākāraṃ carācaramsarvāvayavanirmuktaṃ nirlayaṃ nirvikārajamsarvajñaṃ paripūrṇañca svabhāvaścaivamakṣayammāyātītaṃ nirālambaṃ vyāpakaṃ sarvatomukhamakulavīraṃ mahadbhūtam astināstivivarjitamna kālaḥ kalanāśaktirna śivo na ca indriyaḥna raso hi na sukhaṃ duḥkhameva ca (?)na cchāyā na ca tāpastu na śīto na ca uṣṇavānna sīmā dṛśyate tatra na ca tīrthyaṃ na caiva hi (?)nirākulaṃ nirvikalpañca nibaddhañca malakṣaṇamanigūḍhamasandhiñca sthāvaraṃ jaṅgameva casarvaṃ samarasaṃ pūrṇaṃ akulavīrantu kevalamna tasya mātāpitā (vā)bāndhavaṃ na ca devatātyaktvā vikalpasaṃghātam akulavīralayaṃ gatāḥagnipraveśanaṃ nāsti hemantabhṛgu nodanampitṛkāryaṃ na karotāti tīrthayātrāvratāni casvayaṃ tyaja sarvakāryāṇi lokācārāṇi yāni casaṃkalpañca vikalpañca ye cānye kila dharmiṇaḥsiddhiśca vividhākārā pātāle ca rasāyanamsarvañca pāśajālañca adhomārgapradāyakaḥyathā mṛtāḥ (na) jānanti svādaṃ kaṭumadhurasya tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00003 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathā madirā mahāntasya kathitaṃ nevaśakṛte (?)lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya siddhanāthena bhāṣitammokṣasya tanmahāsthānaṃ mantrarūpavivarjitamlabdhvā tu mokṣasadbhāvam akulavīraṃ malāpahamkuṇḍalī kṛtakā jñeyā sahajā samarase sthitātataḥ sa pātayed bhūmau mudrāmantrairniyojitaiḥetat sādhyamidaṃ tattvaṃ (etad) dhyānañca dhāraṇāvikalpakalalollolā udbhrāntā bhrāntacetasaḥharṣaviṣādasampannā śocyamānā muhurmuhuḥdagdhabījeṣu saṃbhūtiryathā naiva prajāyateakulavīragataṃ bhinnaṃ nānābhāvānubandhanaiḥtadvadkulavīre ca sattve bhrābhrākhya yadgataḥ (?)ajñānamanastadvad bhrāntijālavimohitādadhimadhye yathā sarpiḥ kāṣṭhe cāgniḥ sthito yathāmadyamadhye yathānandaṃ dīpe prabhā samāśritāraktārthākulavīre (?) ca tatsarvaṃ viniyojitamakulavīraṃ na jānanti kṛtakairmohitātmanaḥna jānanti padaṃ śāntamacintyaṃ nityasambhavaḥsarvabhūtasthitaṃ hyekamadhyeyaṃ dhyeyavarjitamtatra mano vilīnantu acalaṃ bhavatanmayamyathā tiṣṭhati tattvasthaḥ śivaniṣkalamavyayeakulavīraṃ mahadbhutamekavīraṃ ca sarvagamkecid vadantīdaṃ dharmamidaṃ śāstramidaṃ tapaḥidaṃ jñānañca vijñānaṃ śuddhāśuddhamidaṃ paramtadāsau yoginī hyekaḥ nānyastu hi dvitīyakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00003 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyañca sthitipralayavarjitamnāhaṃ kaścinna me kaścinna baddho na ca bādhakaḥgacchaṃstiṣṭhan svapan jāgradbhūñjāno maithune'pi vācikitsā naiva kurvīta indriyārthaiḥ kadācanaevaṃ sa carate yogī yathāraṇye hutāśanaḥsomaśūnyastathā vahniprāṇāyāmavivarjitamyena janmasahasrāṇi bhaktyā saṃpūjito guruḥyoginīrākiṇīcakre yasya bhaktiḥ suniścalāpiṇḍātītaṃ yadā jñeyamapiṇḍaṃ piṇḍavarjitamtallīne tanmayātmānaṃ vindate śvāśvataṃ padamnirvāṇaṃ vāsanāhīnaṃ tṛptātmā ca nirāmayaḥtasya pravartate kṣipraṃ tasyaiva sarvasarvagamtāni sarvāṇi mohāni kāyakleśairnirarthakamanarthena ca santuṣṭā bahugranthārthacintakāḥgarvitānāṃ kuto jñānaṃ granthakoṭiśatairapiakulavīrañca dehasthaṃ yadā paśyati sarvagamna kriyā satyaśaucaṃ vā karmakāṇḍe na bhāvanācaritāḥ samayācārā janairbhrāntivimohitaiḥkṛtakā bandhanā loke kalpitāśca kupaṇḍitaiḥsiddhayo vividhā loke pātālaṃ ca rasāyanamsarve te pāśabaddhaśca adhomārgapradāyakāḥyathā madiramānandaṃ kathitaṃ naiva jāyatena jānanti narā mūḍhāḥ sārāt sārataraṃ paramcintātīte yadā yogī sa yogī yogacintakaḥtāvad bhramanti mohātmā nānābhāvānubandhanaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00003 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrkhāṇāṃ ca yathāśāstraṃ kumārīsuratiṃ yathādiśaveśavinirmuktaṃ sthānavarṇavivarjitamanāthaṃ sarvanāthañca pramādonmādavarjitamjale jvalane tathā pavane bhūmyākāśe tathaiva cataṃ jñātaṃ yena dehasthaṃ sa muktaḥ sarvabandhanātna yajño nopavāsaśca na caryā na kriyodayaḥna jāpo nārcanāgnīnāṃ na homo naiva sādhanamniyamāśca na tasyāsti kṣetrapīṭhe ca sevanaiḥnirālambapadaṃ śāntaṃ tathātītaṃ nirañjanamkāryakāraṇanirmuktamacintitañca anāmayamsvadehe saṃsthitaṃ śāntamakulavīraṃ taducyateakulavīraṃ mahadbhūtamastināstivivarjitamna kālakalanā caiva na śaktiśca na cendriyaḥna raso'dhirasaścaiva kṛtakaṃ naiva kārakamna dinaṃ rātrimityuktamudayāstamanavarjitamakṣobhyamacalaṃ śāntamīdṛśaṃ tattvanirṇayamtādṛśaṃ phalamāpnoti nātra kāryavicāraṇātagamyaṃ gamyate kasmād bhrāntijñānavimohitāḥna bharito na rikto vā nipuṇo nāpi cādhikaḥkṛtakairmohitā mūḍhāḥ karmakāṇḍaratāstu yeakulavīraṃ mahadbhūtaṃ yadā paśyati sarvagamnistaraṅgaṃ nirābhāsaṃ padacchedavivarjitamadṛśyaṃ nirguṇaṃ nityaṃ nirṇirodhañca niścalamna recakaṃ pūrakañcaiva narodghātañca (?) kumbhakamgrāhyagrāhakanirmuktagranthātītañca yadbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00003 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sabāhyābhyantaraikatvaṃ sarvatraiva vyavasthitamye ca jñātaṃ svadehasthamakulavīraṃ mahadbhūtamsa brahmā sa hariścaiva sa rudrañcai(ve)śvarastathāsa viśākhyo mayūrākṣo arhanto budhameva casvayaṃ dhyānaṃ svayaṃ dhyātā svayaṃ sarveśvaro guruḥsarvayoginī tatrasthā sarve siddhāśca tatra vaiyathāsau mahārthañca akulavīramiti smṛtamsarve bhīrāśca (?) tatraiva ye pralīnāḥ pralayaṃ gatāḥna hṛdi nābhikaṇṭhe vā vaktre ghaṇṭikarandhrayoḥna nābhicakre kaṇṭhe ca na śire binduke tathāna pūrake kumbhake caiva recake ca tathā punaḥpraveśe nirgame caiva śikhā ūrddhve na bindukena cāpe candrasūrye ca bhāvābhāve samāgameajñānamalagrastātmā mahāmāyāvimohitāḥna vidanti padaṃ śāntaṃ kaivalyaṃ niṣkriyaṃ gurumbauddhārahantāśca ye kecit somasiddhāntadakṣiṇāḥitihāsapurāṇāni bhūtatattvañca gāruḍamvikalpasiddhidāḥ sarve tadvidurna ca paṇḍitāḥna te mucyanti saṃsāre akulavīravivarjitāḥsarvatra saṃsthitaṃ nityaṃ sthāvare jaṅgameṣu caśivādyadevaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitamgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca khānapānādibhakṣaṇaiḥte'pi bandhaiḥ pramucyanti muktimārgī na (?) kāṅkṣiṇaḥviṣākhyo mayūrākṣa (?) ye ca ṛṣayastapodhanāḥte (sarve) mokṣamicchanti akulavīrantu mokṣadam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00003 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvaṃ yaduktā sarve anvayamārge tvakaulike (?)paramāmṛtasantṛptāḥ sahajānandaṃ ca kevalamsarvavyādhiharaścaiva na punarbhavasaṃbhavaḥsarvataḥ sarvadā śuddhaḥ sarvataḥ sarvadā prabhuḥ
